title: Agency Grid Layout Minimal
concept: Parapet, a fictional New York urban beekeeping co-op, presented as a minimal agency site on a strict 12-column grid: oversized tight-tracked Inter Tight headlines, tiny mono uppercase metadata, a greyscale rooftop panorama, hover-shifting practice rows, and an off-white sheet that overlays the page with a honey-by-postcode ledger.
notes: No dependencies beyond Google Fonts (Inter Tight, Geist Mono). Masked headline rise, slow image settle and IntersectionObserver reveals; all motion off under prefers-reduced-motion. Photography from Unsplash, stored locally and graded to greyscale; the honeycomb is the one deliberate colour departure.
